Reminders and follow-ups depend on staff making calls

Online scheduling with doctor availability and reminders
Billing connected to the visit record
ai: Answers routine questions about timings and services, and hands over to staff for anything clinical.
Drafts visit summaries from structured notes for a clinician to review and sign off.
Automated reminders and rescheduling prompts that reduce missed visits.

A multi-doctor clinic scheduling consultations across doctors
A diagnostic centre sharing reports and reminders with patients
